1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de pequeña copa, con tronco de madera quebradiza, corteza y hojas con sabor a especias y frutos en racimos de bayas. Lauraceae Ocotea portoricensis.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub with a small canopy, having a brittle wood trunk, bark, and leaves with a flavor of spices and fruits in clusters of berries. Lauraceae Ocotea portoricensis.
